headline: Micron and Western Digital Shares Decline Amid AI Sector Uncertainty
summary: Shares of Micron Technology and Western Digital (SanDisk parent) fell as investors reacted to concerns regarding the pace of artificial intelligence infrastructure expansion.
why: Micron and Western Digital are major players in the semiconductor and memory storage industries, which are critical components for AI hardware infrastructure.

impacts.name: Micron Technology
impacts.why: Market sentiment regarding AI infrastructure spending has negatively impacted semiconductor stock valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: Western Digital
impacts.why: The company's memory storage business is sensitive to fluctuations in AI-related capital expenditure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors are reassessing the growth trajectory of AI-related capital expenditures, leading to a broad sell-off in semiconductor and hardware stocks.
